notes.title: NUI next steps!
notes.content:
First of all we wanted to thank you everyone for your support with NUI. Making NUI has been a great experience and makes all the hard work put after our actual jobs really worth it.

[h3]NUI current State[/h3]
It's been one month after launching NUI on steam, along this time we have updated the game twice. First update with some bug fixing and small improvements, while in the second one we added some texts in the third level of the game where people seemed to stuck sometimes trying to guess the main mechanic of the game.

[h3]Localization[/h3]
Right now we are currently working on adding multiple language support to the game. This is a feature we wanted to have on the launch day but was impossible for us due to time limitations and due to our ignorance in how many people from different countries will play NUI on steam. With todays update we have the game localized in two languages:
[list]
[*] English
[*] Spanish (Spain)
[/list]

But we would like to support many more languages! 
[list]
[*] Russian
[*] Japanese
[*] Portuguese
[*] German
[*] French
[/list]

[b]It would be wonderful if you wanted to contribute with this translation process! [/b]If you want to help us do not hesitate to write to davidandpixels@gmail.com

[h3]NUI OST[/h3]
Soon we will be adding the awesome music Alex Benet made as a DLC! 
If you want to discover more music and sound  made by him make sure to check his [url=https://twitter.com/AlexBenetAudio]twitter[/url]!

[h3]Next Steps[/h3]
Once this localization update is finished we doubt we will be making a DLC or a sequel but instead we will focus on experimenting more and making another gameplay focused game!

Thanks everyone for your support and see you in the next update!
